result.title: ALLMTS: Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System
result.comment: Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Telephone triage is a safety critical task: from a brief intake note, a nurse must decide whether a caller needs an ambulance, an emergency department, an appointment, or self care at home. Queried directly, large language models (LLMs) are unreliable: they over-escalate routine cases and cannot justify their recommendations against an auditable clinical standard. We present the Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System (ALLMTS), which grounds every disposition in the same commercially maintained telehealth guidelines nurses use. Rather than asking an LLM to triage, ALLMTS makes it execute the guideline: it selects the appropriate guideline and evaluates its triage assessment questions. The disposition follows deterministically from the first positive answer, using the same traversal rule a nurse follows. We evaluate ALLMTS on 566 synthetic, expert-validated scenarios spanning 14 dispositions and designed to test specific guideline questions. ALLMTS achieves 0.95 accuracy, compared with 0.47 for a raw-LLM baseline. On a curated 50-scenario subset released as an open benchmark, ALLMTS reaches 0.98 accuracy, on par with the 0.944 correct disposition rate that a five nurse expert panel recorded on those same scenarios. Critically, on that subset the baselines have over-triage rates of up to 0.50 (0.44 on the full dataset), whereas ALLMTS reduces the over-triage rate to at most 0.02 while maintaining low under-triage. These results support coupling LLM language understanding with executable clinical guidelines for triage from intake notes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ALLMTS：由 LLM 理解电话分诊记录并选择、执行可审计的临床分诊指南，按首个肯定回答确定处置，在合成场景上明显优于直接让 LLM 分诊，并大幅降低过度升级。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将推理外化为指南遍历与「首个肯定回答即停止」的确定性规则，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、证据筛选与升级／降级评价提供对照线索；但属纯文本医疗应用，无 latent 状态或视觉推理，需较多核查。
